single_file: One team.py per experiment, only math and official soccer imports. No submitted benchmark dependencies.
features: Observation-only predictive counter detector, action equivalence against v10.0
Threat-limited goal-side adjustment of the designated cover defender, immediate release on secured possession
Independent high-risk second-defender selector with a hard role-capacity check
Combine only after independent regressions/native/development results; no heldout tuning
role_capacity: User explicitly permits one attacking outlet briefly during high-risk counters. Normal cover preserves the other two runners; emergency support retains GK, chaser, live receiver and at least one outlet, with a non-extending 0.6 second maximum.
development: 48 fixtures/source on six strong opponents and first two fresh development seeds, then 192/source on eight opponents and all six development seeds for positive-point active tactics. At most one development-only refinement may be frozen before any heldout results.
validation: 768 matched fixtures/serious challenger: 12 frozen styles x 16 unused seeds x 2 sides x 2 kickoffs. Separate reserved group per source. Whole-seed paired bootstrap 95%, 5000 resamples, fixed bootstrap RNG. No heldout tuning or pooling failed cohorts.

gates.points: More league points and positive paired whole-seed bootstrap 95% lower bound
gates.official_acceptance: All 5 public seeds (1001-1005), 400 ticks each, zero errors and deadline failures, one controller in team.py
gates.attack_retention: Report goals, points and turnovers; do not promote fewer points for lower goals conceded

timing: Official native 20ms and 2400 ticks, one serial worker, rotated source order. Preserve every initial raw result. Exact timeout-containing fixture repeats max3, accept first clean regardless score. Never repair exceptions or erase raw misses. Record cgroup/CPU/wall; do not attribute unknown failures to environment.
promotion: No modification of my-team/team.py unless all final promotion gates pass. No untested tactics combined.
